text:
A boy wanted to climb a very high mountain. He looked up and saw the top in the clouds. “It’s too far,” he said. “I can’t do it.”

An old man was sitting by the road. “Why are you sad?” he asked.

“The mountain is too big,” said the boy. “I will never reach the top.”

The old man smiled. “Do not look at the top. Look at your feet. Take one step. Then take another. That’s all.”

The boy listened. He started to walk. He looked only at the next step. His legs were tired, but he kept walking. Step by step, he climbed higher.

After many hours, he stopped and looked down. The village looked very small. He was already high up!

He kept going. At last, he reached the top. The wind was cold, and the sky was beautiful. The boy cried with joy.

“I did it!” he shouted. “One step at a time!”

Moral: Big goals become easy when you take small steps.

quiz.q: The boy reached the top of the mountain.
The old man told the boy to look at the top of the mountain.
What advice did the old man give?
o: Look at your feet and take one step at a time
